player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id}. Yu pley Memory Game.
Mipela i amamas long mekim moa pe bilong kad long boda, winim bikim pe bilong yu.
Long taim bilong yu, chusim tupela kad long tanim bek long givim namba bilong lain na namba bilong kolom, olsem '[0 1 1 0]', we kad namba wan i stap long lain 0 na kolom 1, na kad namba tu i stap long lain 1 na kolom 0.
Sapos kad i go pas, yu kisim pe na kad i stap ansap. Sapos kad i no go pas, kad i tanim bek i stap daun, olsem '.'.
Gem i pinis taim ol pe i stap pinis.

board.current_board: Ol i mekim wok long en nau: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: I no orait long dispela pasin. Man i pilai {player_id} em i no bekim stret na makim rot bilong en insait long brackets.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Em i no orait long dispela pasin. Man {player_id} em i makim wanpela posisen we ol man i stap ausait long mak bilong pilai, na em bai go insait tru long ples bung.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Em i no orait long dispela pasin. {player_id} man bilong pilai em i makim wankain kat tupela taim.
invalid_move.already_matched: Em i no orait long dispela pasin. Man {player_id} em i makim wanpela o tupela kat we ol man i bin skelim pinis wantaim narapela kart bilong en.

game_message.cards_match: Kad we Player {player_id} i chusim long ples bilong [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] i go pas!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kad we Player {player_id} i chusim i no go pas. Kad long ples bilong [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] i stap {pos1} na {pos2}.

outcome.draw: Tupela man i pilai wantaim, na ol i kisim wankain namba bilong tupela kat.
outcome.turn_limit: Taim bilong tan i pinis. Gem i pinis. Player 0 i skor {score_0} pe, Player 1 i skor {score_1} pe.
